minor.issue: Fixed by testing agent: server.py L5608 had `SELECTION_RESULT_PASSED_STATUSES | {'penerima_manfaat'}` but SELECTION_RESULT_PASSED_STATUSES is a tuple (L506), causing TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |: 'tuple' and 'set'. rca of the issue: Root cause: Iter47 patch introduced `SELECTION_RESULT_PASSED_STATUSES | {'penerima_manfaat'}` at server.py L5608 assuming SELECTION_RESULT_PASSED_STATUSES was a set, but L506 defines it as a tuple. Python's `|` operator between tuple and set raises TypeError at request-time (not import-time), so build passed but every publish call 500'd. Reproduction: POST /api/admin/selection-announcements/publish with any category and stage='administration' → 500. Fix: `(*SELECTION_RESULT_PASSED_STATUSES, 'penerima_manfaat')` on the same line. All 5 tests in test_selection_announcement_stage.py now green. Retest confirmed.
